\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{القادم} (al-qādim)}{القادم (al-qādim)}]{\ar{القادم} (al-qādim) — next, coming}

\label{lesson:AR-C157-al-qadim}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for once, then the Arabic for to spend.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{القادم}}
\textbf{\ar{القادم}} — \emph{al-qādim} — \textquotedblleft{}next, coming\textquotedblright{}. The future puts \emph{sa-} in front of the present: \textbf{\ar{سأسافر} \ar{الأسبوع} \ar{القادم}} — \emph{sa-usāfiru al-usbūʿa al-qādim} — \textquotedblleft{}I will travel next week.\textquotedblright{}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{al-qādim}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{al-qādim}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Arabic for once, then the Arabic for to spend, then say \emph{al-qādim} again
\end{itemize}
